date_timestamp_literals.timezone_interpretation: The local profile sets spark.sql.session.timeZone=UTC; the timestamp literal is represented as a naive Arrow timestamp by Sparkless. The prior Databricks literal oracle reported Etc/UTC and a UTC-Z wire value for its timestamp literal.

timestamp_boundary.sql: SELECT order_id, CAST(event_ts AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18 03:30:00' AS at_or_after, CAST(event_ts AS TIMESTAMP) < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18 03:30:00' AS before_boundary FROM orders WHERE order_id = 2
timestamp_boundary.boundary_rule: Input event_ts 2026-10-17T23:30:00-04:00 is normalized to 2026-10-18T03:30:00Z. The explicitly cast local comparison is equal to the UTC boundary; >= is true and < is false.
